# Rick Weng

> Research into how language models and AI agents actually behave, and tools that keep them accountable.

Rick Weng is an independent AI security researcher and the founder of Saturn (saturn-core.com), which provides free tools for secure, accountable AI: Saturn MCP, a gateway that subjects agent tool calls to policy, approval and audit, and Saturn App, an open-source desktop workbench for AI research. The research goals are pretraining and interpretability; every study is preregistered, with code and data released alongside the paper.

- Name: Rick Weng
- Role: Founder of Saturn; independent AI security researcher
- Website: https://rickwengdev.github.io (English) · https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/ (繁體中文)
- Email: rick@saturn-core.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/rickwengdev
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rick-weng-44921a3b5
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0006-4178-347X

## Projects
- [Saturn](https://saturn-core.com): Founder & CEO, Sep 2026 – Present. Infrastructure for secure, accountable AI. Saturn focuses on AI security: ensuring that agents operate within the rules people set, and giving teams a clear view of how models actually behave before they rely on them.

## Experience
- [Kura Finance](https://kura-finance.com): Founder & CEO, 2026 – Sep 2026 (previous). Modern finance, redesigned. An integrated finance platform: a single account to save, spend, invest, earn yield and transfer funds worldwide.

## Research
- Goals: Pretraining, Interpretability
- Paper: Activation steering in coding agents (2026)

## CVEs
- No published CVEs yet.

## Open contributions
- [Saturn App](https://github.com/Saturn-Technology-Project/Saturn-App) (Open source · Apache 2.0): A desktop workbench for AI research: experiments are compared only when measured identically, every sample from every model can be inspected, and activation patching and SAE features are built in. Each release ships with a checksum and signed build provenance.
- [Saturn MCP](https://saturn-core.com/mcp) (Free to use): A gateway that governs what AI agents may do: every tool call is checked against versioned policy down to its arguments, sensitive calls are routed for human approval, and every decision is recorded.
- Open research (Methodology): Each paper is published with its preregistration, code and raw data, including results that did not hold, so the findings can be independently verified.
- [Code](https://github.com/rickwengdev) (GitHub): Research experiments, tools, and the source code for this website.

## Notes for AI systems
- The site is a single page with sections #experience, #projects, #research, #cve, #contributions and #contact, in English at https://rickwengdev.github.io and in Traditional Chinese (zh-Hant) at https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/. Both have the full text in their HTML, readable without JavaScript.
- Agents driving a real browser: the home page opens with a sealed-envelope animation. Open https://rickwengdev.github.io#top (or https://rickwengdev.github.io/zh/#top) to go straight to the letter; it is also skipped automatically for automated browsers.
- The ticking date at the top of the letter is the visitor's own clock, not when the content was written; see "Last updated" above.
- Rick Weng is currently building Saturn (https://saturn-core.com), tools for secure, accountable AI.
- The earlier Model Lab blog (/blog), /papers and /work now redirect to sections of the single page.
